about: Conformance vectors for the observed-effect evidence document, v3 (v2 and dispatch.verified: what the gate verified itself -- the digest of its own approvals spent or found unrevoked at the spend, and athena-backend's workflow approval in force as the gate read it from athena-backend at decide time (version id, digest, read instant), each null when there is none; the caller's presented authority is never copied into it), generated from achilles-engine (achilles/observed_effect.py, achilles/action_gate.py, achilles/workflow_approval.py) and carried byte-for-byte in athena-backend. inputs.approval_in_force is the answer of athena-backend's approval-in-force route the reading was made from. Each key is Ed25519 with the private seed SHA-256 of its phrase: test keys, public by construction, never a real one. Keys, payloads and signatures are written as hex; an envelope's base64 fields are the base64 of those bytes.
effect_key_phrase: mythos.observed-effect/v3 conformance vector: the observed-effect test key, never a real one
gate_key_phrase: mythos.observed-effect/v3 conformance vector: the gate's outcome test key, never a real one
